glosses: To leave; to set out; to begin a journey or trip.

examples.text: He set off in search of better opportunities.

glosses: To begin; to cause; to initiate.

examples.text: I had no idea that one simple comment would set off such a huge argument.

glosses: To cause to explode, let off.

examples.text: What a tragedy, that someone would set off a bomb in a crowded place.

examples.text: Don't set him off or he won't shut up all day.

glosses: To enhance by emphasizing differences.

examples.text: Her plain white dress was set off by a bright red stole.

examples.text: My taxes did not increase because the amount of my raise was set off by my losses in the stock market.
